snippet.title: ترامب وبوتين وشي يقتسمون العالم.. هل باعوا إيران؟ وماذا ينتظر الخليج؟
snippet.description:
ما هي تداعيات استبعاد إيران من قمة شنزن النووية 2026؟ تحليل لمستقبل العلاقات الدولية في ظل غياب طهران عن طاولة المفاوضات الكبرى.

اشتركوا في قناة من صلب الواقع لمتابعة تحليلات سياسية معمقة حول الشرق الأوسط، وشاركونا في التعليقات: هل تعتقدون أن استبعاد إيران سيزيد من حدة التوتر في المنطقة؟

Güller ve Günahlar yeni bölümüyle her cumartesi 20.00'da Kanal D'de!

Tüm Bölümler 👉 https://www.kanald.com.tr/guller-ve-gunahlar/bolumler

Dürüstlük, aile bağları ve güven üzerine kurduğu hayatıyla tanınan başarılı iş insanı Serhat, eşi Berrak’ın yıllardır sakladığı büyük bir gerçeği öğrenince sarsılır. Berrak’ın geçirdiği talihsiz kaza sonrası komaya girmesi, Serhat’ı yanıtlarını bulmak için zorlu bir yolculuğa çıkarır. Bu süreçte, yoksul bir mahallenin cesur ve açık sözlü kızı Zeynep ile yolları kesişir. Farklı dünyalara ait Serhat ve Zeynep, ihanet, aşk ve gizli sırların gölgesinde aynı fırtınaya kapılır. Kalplerinin çağrısına karşı koymaya çalışsalar da, geçmişin karanlık yüzü onları geri dönüşü olmayan bir yola sürükler.  

Güller ve Günahlar’da Murat Yıldırım başarılı iş insanı Serhat karakteri ile Cemre Baysel ise fakir mahallenin cesur ve dobra kızı Zeynep rolüyle izleyici karşısına çıkmaya hazırlanıyor. İkiliye önemli rollerde Oya Unustası, Gülenay Kalkan, Serdar Orçin, Emel Çölgecen, Ahmet Saraçoğlu, Aleyna Solaker, Kaan Çakır, Serdar Özer, Gizem Sevim, Neslihan Arslan, Emre Özcan, Merve Su Bengi ve Mina Akdin gibi yıldızlar kadrosu eşlik ediyor. Dizinin sevimli yıldızlarına ise Beren Gençalp ve Yade Arayıcı hayat veriyor.
Deniz Can Çelik yönetmenliğinde ekrana gelecek olan Güller ve Günahlar, hayatını dürüstlük, aile sevgisi ve güven üzerine kuran Serhat’ın (Murat Yıldırım), eşi Berrak’ın yıllardır sakladığı büyük bir sırrı öğrenmesiyle alt üst olan hayatına odaklanıyor. ปี 2499 “หงเสน” (ฟอส จิรัชพงศ์) ฉายา หงเสนเก้ายอด หัวหน้าแก๊งเก้ายอดคุมย่านฝั่งธนบุรี และ “เส็ง” (เกรท สพล) ฉายา เส็งคลุกฝุ่น หัวหน้าแก๊งคลุกฝุ่นคุมย่านฝั่งพระนคร เปิดศึกปะทะเดือดจากปมแค้นในอดีตที่ยังไม่คลี่คลาย แต่ท่ามกลางศึกสองแก๊งที่พร้อมปะทะกันทุกเมื่อ ความรักกลับก่อตัวขึ้นระหว่าง “หงเสน-ย้ง (บุ๊ค กษิดิ์เดช)” น้องชายของเส็ง และ “เส็ง-โซ่ (ไบร์ท รพีพงศ์)” ชายหนุ่มที่เพิ่งเข้าแก๊งมาใหม่  เมื่อความรักความแค้นและความลับในอดีตเริ่มเข้ามาพัวพัน

Este viernes 20 de noviembre, la Ciudad de México conmemora la Revolución Mexicana con el tradicional desfile cívico-militar. En el desfile de la Revolución Mexicana 2026 participan:

2 mil 969 elementos de las Fuerzas Armadas y la Guardia Nacional.
486 caballos y 16 vehículos antiguos.
10 contingentes históricos.
16 compañías militares caracterizadas como villistas, zapatistas, carrancistas y obregonistas.

Representaciones de Francisco I. Madero, Venustiano Carranza, Carmen y Natalia Serdán, y Hermila Galindo.

También destaca la participación de las Adelitas del contingente “Mártires de la Libertad”, así como la presencia de elementos militares que explican el significado de esta conmemoración.

snippet.title: It turns out that Americans actually care about corruption.
snippet.description:
In 2025, we asked an adviser to Donald Trump Jr. about the ethical issues posed by the presidential son’s business activities. “Write your ridiculous story. Literally no one cares,” he shot back. “We don’t actually give a fuck.”

That last sentence was clearly true. Since the 47th president returned to office, he and his family have added billions of dollars to their net worth, brazenly profiting from crypto deals, real estate projects, and other ventures. But it turns out that Americans actually care quite a bit. An October Financial Times poll found that 69 percent of respondents were very or somewhat concerned about “corruption, self-dealing, or conflicts of interest” in the Trump administration. Even a few GOP politicians are noticing. In September, Sen. John Curtis of Utah urged his colleagues to haul Don Jr. before Congress and investigate the “use of presidential family relationships for private financial benefit.”

Mother Jones reporters Russ Choma and Dan Friedman outline some of the investigations that we will likely be seeing soon from a Democrat-led Congress.  Read the full list in our story at MotherJones.com.

snippet.title: SAPS, BMA officers nabbed for facilitating illegal immigration
snippet.description:
Police in the Free State have made a major breakthrough in the fight against corruption at the borders. 

They have arrested six SAPS members, and three Border Management officials, at the Van Rooyen's Gate, Port of Entry between South Africa and Lesotho. 

The suspects face charges of corruption, fraud and defeating the ends of justice. 

They are accused of processing passports without following proper processes. 

The arrests were part of a joint undercover operation, dubbed Operation Cairo, targeting illegal activities at the country's ports of entry.
